# Microsoft MIDI-CI headers

`MidiCiMessage.h` and `MidiCiResponder.h` are unmodified copies from
[microsoft/MIDI](https://github.com/microsoft/MIDI/tree/183460a604e82f4ec47cba2b213d970710b4d999/src/in-box/Inc)
at commit `183460a604e82f4ec47cba2b213d970710b4d999`, the same revision used by
MIDI2Sound. The headers are MIT licensed. See `LICENSE`.
